constituency_identity.boundary_comparability_notice: Boundary comparability: Pre-2008 delimitation boundaries differed in geographical extent. Direct comparison is indicative rather than exact.

constituency_story.summary: Duddhi (AC #403) in Sonbhadra district has demonstrated dynamic electoral competitiveness across the historical record. In the latest 2022 Assembly election, the winning margin was 6,297 votes (3.08%) won by RAMDULAR (BJP) with 84,407 votes, compared with a margin of 1,085 votes (0.55%) in the 2017 election won by HAR IRAM (ADAL) with 64,399 votes. Voter turnout stood at 61.58% in 2022 compared to 63.82% in 2017. Prior to the 2008 delimitation, this seat's predecessor territorial area was designated as AC #382 (2000–2008) and AC #398 (1976–2000).
